title: Methane synthesis from CO2 and H2O with concentrated NaOH–KOH electrolyte at 200–250 °C using electrochemical Pd–Ag membrane reactor
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,2070-2080
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01657F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wakana Seki, Raisei Sagara, Aika Hirata, Jun Kubota
Methane was synthesized from CO2 and H2O using a Ru/C catalyst in an electrochemical Pd–Ag membrane reactor with a NaOH–KOH electrolyte at 250 °C and 250 mA cm−2, achieving a current efficiency of 91%.
